meta.title: Grandma · Waitlist open — Brasil first, then the US
meta.description: A calm companion for your cycle, pregnancy, kids and menopause. Join the waitlist: invites open in Brasil first, then the United States.

hero.lede: Cycle, pregnancy, the first years and menopause — one calm companion who remembers everything, judges nothing, and answers at 3am.

chapters.title: One companion, four chapters.
chapters.sub: The whole app reshapes itself around where you are. Switch any time — Grandma keeps your history.

grandma.title: Meet Grandma.
grandma.quote: The friend who's awake at 3am — and actually knows things.
grandma.body: She knows your kids by name, remembers their ages and sleep patterns, tells you what the science says and what your grandmother would have done — and lets you decide.
grandma.videoAlt: Asking Grandma a question in the app

items.a: Invites open in Brasil first, then in the United States. Within each country we go in the order people joined, and we never skip ahead.

items.q: Is it only for pregnancy and babies?
items.a: No. Grandma has four chapters: Cycle, Pregnancy, Kids (newborn to five) and Menopause. Switch any time — she keeps your history.
Free to start. An optional Premium plan adds more, and you'll see it before you ever pay.
Yes. Your data is encrypted, never sold, and never used to train AI models. You can export it or delete your account at any time.

footer.tag: A calm companion for your cycle, pregnancy, kids and menopause.
